title: Human-Centric Multimodal Machine Learning: Recent Advances and Testbed on AI-based Recruitment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure aspects of faith/religion. Its focus was on gender and ethnicity biases in a simulated, AI-based recruitment scenario.
findings: The paper did not contain any findings related to religion. The study's scope was limited to gender and ethnic biases.
